# Congratulations! Congratulations on being chosen to work on one of many state of the art research stations in the Monachopsis-Omicron sectors. Whether you are a new hire or worked with us previously, you will be working towards the pursuit of life-changing technology. If you have worked with us before there are some changes in this sector you must adhere to. While you currently work for NanoTrasen, CentCom has the final say during station disputes.
Due to an agreement with CentCom they will be providing us the data they have obtained in return for more resources to continue their own work. If you are working as command on your shift and have a particular issue that the station is unable to handle, please report to your Captain or nearest CC representative to get a rapid response from Central Command.
